# Tromme

> Tromme is a dedicated music player app for Plex Media Server on iPhone and iPad. It offers lossless streaming, word-synced lyrics, crossfade, offline downloads and CarPlay, and it works with any standard Plex account with no Plex Pass required.

Tromme requires iOS or iPadOS 27 or later and a Plex Media Server. It is not affiliated with Plex, Inc. Tromme does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data; the Plex token is stored in the iOS Keychain on the device.

## Features

- No Plex Pass required: Works with any standard Plex account
- New Home: The whole library on Home with the Plex profile, plus choosable and reorderable sections
- Custom tab bar, Genres to browse and shuffle, and search on every library list
- Artist Mixes on Home and CarPlay that change every hour
- Lossless streaming: FLAC files play as lossless Apple Lossless (ALAC)
- Crossfade: Free, with a length of 3, 5, 7 or 10 seconds
- Magic Mix, stations and Infinite Mode: Endless mixes matched by style, genre and mood
- Word-synced lyrics: Highlight word by word, saved with downloads for offline use
- Offline downloads: Songs, albums, playlists or the whole library, plus Music Cache
- Apple Music covers, artist photos and artist logos
- Automatic metadata: Apple Music details and Last.fm moods and styles for new albums and artists
- Share songs and albums as an image
- Playlists grid view with more sorting, iPad sidebar, and true black or dark gray dark modes
- Plex Home users with PIN support, each with their own settings
- Concerts on artist pages, tag and artwork editing, and Siri ("Play Abbey Road in Tromme")
- Album details, Sound Check, cellular-aware transcoding and CarPlay

## Tromme Plus

Tromme is free to use. The optional Tromme Plus subscription adds AutoMix (smart crossfades timed from the last lyric of one song to the first of the next), Cleanup Library (match the whole library with Apple Music), premium app icons, animated album artwork, track trim and higher bitrate downloads.
